objective: Close the four follow-ups the last review found in the extension's Bun lookup, so a usable Bun is never passed over and a found path is the one that runs.
scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-win, branch release/0.3.0/fix/pi-windows-launch, head b511fe3 (committed; your edits are a new change on top).

1. packages/integrations/pi/src/extension.ts:635-638 (cmdExeArguments): when the Bun found is a bun.cmd shim and cmd.exe refuses the command line (a project path with ( ) & | < > and no space, or any % ^ !), every holyagent call fails, although ~/.bun/bin/bun.exe may exist. When a candidate cannot be started safely, try the next candidate in the lookup order, and fail naming the reason only when none can.
2. extension.ts:826-832: a found Bun path is cached for the session; when spawning it fails because the file is gone (ENOENT), clear the cache and look again once.

3. extension.ts:614-620: relative PATH entries (bin, ./node_modules/.bin) are checked against the process cwd but the spawn runs in packageRoot; skip relative PATH entries, as a shell would not search them safely, and make the doc comment's claim true.
4. extension.ts:576: on POSIX, skip a PATH candidate without the executable bit, as command -v in the wrapper does.
Test each under stubbed platform and file system. Leave item 5 (both BUN_INSTALL and ~/.bun searched) and the bun-flags machinery as they are.
